text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During her first three years in the Twinkle Series,
Hishi Miracle pulled off miracle after miracle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Considering she was completely overlooked at first, her path has been nothing short of a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the future looks bright.
The two of us decided to talk over
how we're going to proceed from here.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Now Trainer-san, it's okonomiyaki time.
Okonomiyaki!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's a pep rally, so surf clams are a must.
You can't leave out the adductor muscle, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eat up, eat up! You can totally leave
all the grilling to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Miracle's homemade okonomiyaki
kept getting flipped off the grill one after another...
choice_data_list: From here on, shall we aim to win every GⅠ race we enter?
From here on, shall we aim to win every GⅠ race we enter?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that sounds nice.
Seems rewarding.
choice_data_list: Maybe an overseas campaign wouldn't be a bad idea.
Maybe an overseas campaign would be nice.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Overseas... That scale sounds
pretty incredible, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still, it sounds pretty tough.
Like, just hearing about it doesn't really paint the whole picture, y'know?
choice_data_list: What do you want to do, Hishi Miracle?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, me...?
choice_data_list: Yeah, what's your number one wish?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That matters more than anything. What Hishi Miracle,
having achieved so many great feats, wants to do most is...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Umm, to tell the truth,
my number one wish is~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to eat this okonomiyaki
before it gets cold!"
...Or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's my masterpiece, you know? And it's super tasty!
So please, give it a try~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...It seemed the race was barely on her mind.
choice_data_list: Are you not really feeling up to it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: That's not true at all~ Of course there is. It's just...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: “It means my motivation won't change, no matter what the goal is.”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I feel like as long as I'm aiming for it with you, Trainer,
any goal can become a dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle let her thoughts drift
to the days that would continue ahead...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I just want the two of us, Trainer and me,
to get along and have fun together.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It seems like I'll still be relying on you a lot as always, but
I really want to stay in your care.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And then, I want to eat delicious food
all over the place!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Okonomiyaki is great, but
there are plenty of other options too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Also, my allowance! I want Mom to
recognize my hard work a bit more!
I want a raise!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And I'd love to run in a lot of races too.
Though winning would be the absolute best~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Even if I can't win, I want to give it everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thinking about it like this, even though I say I don't have a dream...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Aren't you full of big dreams?
choice_data_list: Was everything you just said a dream?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even if each one is small,
when they all gather together as one...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's a magnificent, all-inclusive dream!
Just like a loaded okonomiyaki!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Hishi Miracle said
was certainly true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: No matter how small, a dream is still a dream. Gathering them together will color Hishi Miracle's future...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer. You know what I think?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I bet everyone who came to the racetrack to watch
feels the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That means your wish is the same as mine.
In other words~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I just hope something nice happens.
And I hope those little nice things keep happening.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Maybe seeing the Umamusume you root for win
is just one of those "little good things" in life.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: That's why I will run! From now on, too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"So that everyone and I
can feel just a little bit happier."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: What I want to eat with you every day, Trainer, is... yes—!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: An okonomiyaki packed with all kinds of little delights!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Yes, at the racetrack, there's always a little bit of joy to be found. And everyone is chasing after it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might not be anything grand
like world conquest or rapid career advancement. But—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That very joy is Hishi Miracle's dream.
And...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The dream that everyone saw on that day—
in Hishi Miracle's running.
